title: Adaptive intake gateway for cross-tenant analytics and export requests
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background: Enterprise customers frequently submit ad-hoc analytics and export requests to the Console (cost breakdowns, tenant-level usage slices, scheduled CSV exports, and dashboard builds). Current intake is heterogeneous (support tickets, emails, CSMs) and lacks a consistent prioritization signal, which results in long lead times and missed SLAs for high-value customers.

Goal: Design and deliver an adaptive intake gateway in the Console that classifies incoming analytics/export requests, assigns an SLA lane (urgent / standard / backlog), and surface minimal required metadata for scoping and automated routing to the right delivery path (self-serve, data ops, product team). The gateway should reduce triage time, improve SLA adherence for enterprise customers, and create a structured backlog for prioritization.

Success metrics: 
- Median first-response time for enterprise analytics requests reduced from current baseline to <48h for urgent lane.
- % of requests auto-classified with sufficient metadata >= 75%.
- Decrease in ad-hoc Slack/CSM escalations related to reporting requests by 40% quarter-over-quarter.

Scope (in):
- Console UI intake form and router that collects standardized fields (tenant, workspace size, data range, export format, business use case, sensitivity).
- SLA scoring heuristic combining tenant contract tier, estimated compute cost, and requester role.
- Routing rules: self-serve, scheduled export onboarding, product/PM review, data ops queue.
- Telemetry events for each intake step and a simple dashboard for intake health.

Out of scope (for initial iteration):
- Full-fledged self-serve report builder (follow-up project).
- Automated heavy ETL work; these remain routed to data ops.

Acceptance criteria:
- Console intake form prototyped and validated with at least 3 enterprise customers and Solutions team.
- SLA scoring logic implemented as a deterministic rule set and documented.
- Routing triggers (email/issue creation) connected to triage queues and verified end-to-end in staging.
- Instrumentation emits telemetry for request counts, lanes, and time-to-route across tenants.

Notes: This ticket is focused on product-side design and prioritization rules; implementation will require ENG stories for UI, API endpoints, and telemetry, plus a short Solutions enablement playbook.
